answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 300 aliases means 300 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit. The epoch seed changes, so yesterday's solutions cannot be replayed. A comet of doubt is healthy, a jade of proof is required, and a plume of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
